motion.name: tint-hover
motion.purpose: Hover is a tint change; reduced motion collapses it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b13f16; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #b13f16; border-radius: 0.25rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.5rem; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9f3914; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b13f16; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Secondary action on the paper palette.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ece6d8; color: #1c1a15; border: 1px solid #d9d2c1; border-radius: 0.25rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.5rem; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e2dbc9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b13f16; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Filter chip with a count; selected state fills with the accent.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 36px; padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #1c1a15; background: #ece6d8; border: 1px solid #d9d2c1; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip span { color: #5b564b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b13f16; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skill Row
components.description: Ruled list row: mono name, summary, copy action.
components.html:
css-fade-up-reveal

Library-free scroll polish with an IntersectionObserver reveal.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid #d9d2c1; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1a15; } .ds-row a { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 500; color: #b13f16; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-row p { margin: 0; } .ds-row button { justify-self: start; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 0.75rem; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #b13f16; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #d9d2c1; border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
A reference you carry because it is trusted: warm paper, hairline rules, a condensed heading face that reads like a stamped label, and one signal-orange accent used the way a manual uses a tab or a warning mark. The deep-dive pages are the product, so the interface serves finding and reading them.

The look is deliberately not the stock Docusaurus template it replaced. Light and dark modes both exist; the dark mode is a warm near-black, not a blue-gray.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and ink, never pure white or black; one accent.
Hairline rules and ruled indexes instead of cards for structure.
Condensed display face for headings; mono only for commands and skill names.
Flat: depth comes from tone and rules, not shadow.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange marks what is clickable or current. It never fills a section background.

rules.name: The Frontmatter Is Normative Rule
rules.body: Accent ramps live in src/css/custom.css as --ifm-color-primary-*; the design file mirrors them. Change the CSS first.

rules.name: The Typeable Rule
rules.body: Mono is for things a reader can type or copy. It is never a costume for technical.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts at rest or on hover; hover is a tint change.

dos: Do keep light and dark modes, with the dark palette warm.
Do derive counts and skill lists from skills-data.ts; never type a number in copy.
Do use ruled rows and indexes for structure.
Do keep every interactive target at 44px or larger.
donts: Don't fill sections with the accent or use it for decoration.
Don't use cards of icon, heading and text as page structure.
Don't use a colored side border on callouts, list items or menu items.
Don't hardcode N skills anywhere; the build computes it.
Don't break the generated catalog or pnpm docs:check.
